content.title: [Weather] Spring rain in parts of the country tomorrow (18th)... Fine dust to clear from the afte...
content.text: Tomorrow morning, ultrafine dust concentrations in Seoul and southern Gyeonggi will soar to "very poor" levels, and many other regions will also see "poor" levels of concentration until the morning. This is because air flow remains stagnant until tomorrow morning, causing the fine dust accumulated today to remain in the atmosphere. Starting tomorrow afternoon, spring rain will fall, causing ultrafine dust concentrations to gradually decrease. Rain will begin in Chungcheong and Honam regions early tomorrow morning, and will fall across most of the country by the morning. Up to 30mm of rain is expected along the southern coast, while 5 to 10mm will fall in the central region. In the mountainous areas of Gangwon Province, where temperatures are low, up to 5cm of snow will accumulate. Tomorrow morning, temperatures in most of the central region will start above freezing, dropping to around 10 degrees Celsius during the day. Daytime temperatures in the Honam region will be lower than today, remaining at 11 degrees Celsius. Inland Yeongnam, which neared 20 degrees Celsius during the day today, will see temperatures more than 5 degrees lower tomorrow, with Daegu reaching 13 degrees. Waves will reach a maximum height of 3.5 meters in the South Sea. Generally clear weather will continue from the day after tomorrow for the time being. That was the weather report.
